app.name: Silsilah
app.tagline: Turn handwritten family trees into a family archive you can share.

home.step1: Use your phone's camera or choose photos you already have. Trees that span several pages are fine.
home.step2: Every name, date and connection is shown next to the original. Anything we're unsure of is marked for you to confirm.
home.step3: Invite relatives to view the tree or help complete it. You decide who can make changes.
home.privacy: Your family's history stays private unless you choose to share it.
home.headline: Every family has a story
home.lede: Photograph the family tree your grandparents wrote by hand. Silsilah reads the names and connections, lets you check every detail, and keeps it safe to share with the relatives who remember.
home.caption: The Hasan family, as written in 1972

login.title: Sign in or create an account
login.intro: Enter your email and we'll send you a link. New here? Your account is created the moment you click it. No password needed.
login.checkBody: We sent a sign-in link to your inbox. It works once and expires in one hour.
login.checkSpam: Can't find it? Check your spam folder, or go back and try again.
login.error: Something went wrong signing you in. Please try again.
login.inviteHint: Sign in or create an account to join the family tree you were invited to.
login.emailHint: We'll email you a link. There is no password to remember.
login.errorEmail: We couldn't send the sign-in email just now. Please try again in a few minutes. If it keeps happening, the site's email settings need attention.
login.errorExpired: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Enter your email again for a new one.
login.passwordLink: Sign in with a password instead
login.passwordIntro: A temporary way in while email sign-in is being set up. Enter your email and the password you were given. New here? Your account is created when you sign in.
login.passwordError: That email or password isn't right. Please try again.
login.passwordBack: Sign in with an email link instead

trees.title: My trees
trees.empty: You don't have any family trees yet.
trees.createIntro: Give it a name and choose how to start: an empty tree you fill from photos or by hand, or a ready-made family shape you fill in with real names.
trees.nameHint: For example, “Keluarga Hasan” or “The Wiryo family”.

tree.noPeople: No people in this tree yet.

tree.removeConnectionConfirm: Remove the connection between {a} and {b}? Both people stay in the tree.
tree.relativeHint: You can add dates and other details after adding them.
tree.connectExisting: Connect to someone already in the tree
tree.removePersonConfirm: Remove {name} from the tree? Their connections are removed with them.
tree.addPersonHint: Add someone who isn't connected yet. You can connect them afterwards from their card.
tree.addFirstHint: Start with anyone, often yourself or the oldest ancestor you know. Then add their parents, children and spouse from their card.
tree.errorConflict: Someone else changed this just now. Reload to see their version, then make your change again.
tree.errorTooManyParents: This person already has two parents.
tree.errorCycle: That would make someone their own ancestor.
tree.errorSelf: A person can't be connected to themselves.

tree.errorGeneric: That didn't work. Please try again.
tree.renameInvalid: Please enter a name of up to 120 characters.
tree.otherParentHint: Choose “not known” for a child from another relationship. They'll show as a step-child of the spouse.
tree.otherParentUnknown: Not known or not in the tree
tree.conflictIntro: Someone else saved changes to this person while you were editing. For each detail you both changed, choose which to keep. Their other changes are kept.
tree.conflictNothing: Your changes don't clash with theirs.
tree.suggestHint: Correct anything that's wrong or missing. An editor of this tree will review your suggestion before it's applied.
tree.suggestSent: Thank you. An editor will review your suggestion.

tree.suggestionsTitle: {count, plural, =1 {1 suggested change} other {# suggested changes}}
tree.errorSuggestion: Change at least one detail to send a suggestion.
tree.errorOtherParent: Choose someone else in the tree as the other parent.

invite.signInFirst: Sign in or create an account to join

admin.title: Admin
admin.privacyNote: App-wide numbers only. Being an admin doesn't give you access to anyone's family tree.
admin.howToChange: Admins are set in the ADMIN_EMAILS environment variable. Change it in Vercel and redeploy.

merge.noDecisions: No decisions yet. Once people accept or reject suggestions, the numbers appear here so the matching thresholds can be tuned.

footer.privacy: Silsilah keeps family trees private. Only the people you invite can see yours. Photos are read once and never stored: we keep only the names and connections you confirm, and you can delete a tree at any time.

upload.title: Photograph the family tree
upload.lede: Take a photo of each page, or choose photos you already have. Your photos stay on this device: each one is sent once to be read, then discarded.
upload.tip1: Lay the page flat in good, even light.
upload.tip2: Fit the whole page in the frame.
upload.readPages: {count, plural, =1 {Read this page} other {Read these # pages}}
upload.readRemaining: {count, plural, =1 {Read the remaining page} other {Read the remaining # pages}}
upload.readingHint: This usually takes under a minute per page. Please keep this screen open.
upload.retrying: The reading service is busy. Trying again…
upload.okFound: {people, plural, =1 {Found 1 person} other {Found # people}} and {links, plural, =1 {1 connection} other {# connections}}.
upload.okUnclear: {count, plural, =1 {1 item needs a closer look.} other {# items need a closer look.}}
upload.rejectedTitle: This doesn't look like a family tree
upload.rejectedHint: A family tree photo shows names connected by lines, brackets, arrows or rows, or a written list that says who is whose child or spouse.
upload.borderlineTitle: We could only partly read this page
upload.borderline_low_confidence: The writing was hard to read.
upload.borderline_no_relationships: We found names, but no lines or words showing how they are related.
upload.borderline_mostly_illegible: Most of the names were unreadable.
upload.continueAnyway: Continue and fill in by hand
upload.continued: You chose to keep this page and complete it by hand.
upload.summary: {people, plural, =1 {1 person} other {# people}} found across {pages, plural, =1 {1 page} other {# pages}}.
upload.startOverConfirm: Remove all photos and results from this device?
upload.noPersist: This browser can't keep photos between visits, so please finish in one go.
upload.viewerOnly: You can view this tree, but only editors can add pages. Ask an owner to make you an editor.
upload.cropHelp: Drag the corners so the box covers only the family tree.

review.title: Review what we found
review.lede: Check each name, date and connection against your photo. Anything highlighted in amber needs a look. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
review.attentionNone: Everything has been checked. Save when you're ready.
review.attentionCount: {count, plural, =1 {1 item is highlighted in amber.} other {# items are highlighted in amber.}} Compare them with the photo, correct them, or mark them as right.
review.existingQ: “{name}” is already in this tree. Is this the same person?
review.removePersonConfirm: Remove {name} and their connections from this review?
review.fullNameHint: As written, including titles such as H. or Hj.
review.dateHint: Partial dates are fine, for example 1952 or ~1950.
review.livingAuto: Work it out from the dates
review.mergeHint: Combines the two entries into one and keeps all their connections.
review.previewHint: How everyone connects, one row per generation. Wide families scroll sideways.
review.noPhoto: The photo for this page is no longer on this device.
review.issue_cycle: These connections would make {names} their own ancestor.
review.issue_no_people: There is no one to save.
review.save: Save {count, plural, =1 {1 person} other {# people}} to {tree}
review.saveBlocked: Fix the problems listed above to save.
review.saveErrorRelationships: Some connections don't fit together; please check them.
review.savedLocal: Your changes are kept on this device until you save.
review.rebuilt: The pages changed since you last reviewed, so this review was rebuilt from the latest reading.

blank.title: An empty tree
blank.hint: Add people from photos of a handwritten tree, or type them in.

scratch.title: Start from scratch
scratch.hint: Begin with yourself, then add each person and connect them one by one.

parents-children.hint: 5 people: a couple and their three children.

grandparents.title: Me and my grandparents
grandparents.hint: 7 people: you, your parents and all four grandparents.

descendants.title: A couple's descendants

nasab.hint: 5 generations, from you back to your great-great-grandfather, as in a nasab.

two-marriages.title: Two marriages

templates.reviewLede: Replace each highlighted placeholder with a real name, and add dates if you know them. Remove anyone who doesn't fit, or add more people and connections below. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
templates.scratchLede: Start by replacing “Me” with your name. Then use “Add a person” and “Add a connection” below to build out your family, with dates and places if you know them. Nothing is saved until you press Save.

deleted.title: Recently deleted
deleted.lede: People removed from this tree in the last {days} days. Restoring someone also brings back their connections. After {days} days they're removed for good.

merge.title: Matching trees
merge.lede: These trees seem to describe some of the same people. Nothing changes until you accept, and you can undo it afterwards.
merge.none: No possible matches right now. We check again whenever a tree you edit changes.
merge.matches: {count, plural, =1 {1 matching person} other {# matching people}}
merge.linkedAs: {mine} is the same person as {theirs} in {tree}
merge.reviewLede: Tick the people who really are the same. Both trees stay as they are; matched people are linked, and you choose which details to keep where they differ.
merge.hiddenRequester: A possible match was found with another family's tree ({count, plural, =1 {1 matching person} other {# matching people}}). Their owners have been asked; you will see the details if they agree.
merge.hiddenResponder: Another family's tree may include some of the same people. Only people from your own tree are shown until you allow the connection.
merge.requestPrompt: Do you want to connect with this family's tree? Allowing lets both families review the matches. Nothing is changed in your tree by allowing.

kind.direct: connected as parent and child in both trees
